title: 學員匯入 — Stateless Mapping API 與原子寫入
content: 為 AF-021 實作檔案檢視、mapping preview 與 confirm API。使用 AF-019 raw-table parser，依 zero-based source index 驗證管理員 mapping；preview/confirm 每次重新上傳與重驗，無 importId/server preview store。確認只建立新 User，整批單一 transaction，任一錯誤完整 rollback。移除 temp-store/importId 流程並保留 ADMIN、10MB、檔案類型檢查。

commands: npx --yes tsx --test src/lib/data/parser.test.mts src/lib/data/import/mapping.test.mts src/lib/data/import/registrants.test.mts src/lib/is-same-origin.test.mts
DATABASE_URL=<isolated loopback DB> npx prisma migrate deploy
findings: 25 focused tests passed, including isolated PostgreSQL commit/rollback coverage
AF-028 API smoke passed authentication, origin validation, inspect, mapping rejection, read-only preview, confirmation, and duplicate replay
typecheck and production build pass; lint has 0 errors and 2 unrelated FAQ warnings
Disposable test database returned to zero AF-028 users and was stopped; existing lmc-postgres container was untouched
evidence.residual: AF-021's current UI still submits importId and must be integrated before the new API can be used end to end. XLSX parsing remains memory-backed behind the 10MB upload cap.

comments.name: User
comments.text: Approved flexible source-header mapping direction; Variant C is the selected UI.

acceptance: Inspect request returns source indices/labels and at most 3 sample rows without persisting files, rows, mappings, or sessions
Mapped preview and confirm accept file plus source-index mapping; server validates source bounds, allowlisted targets, uniqueness, and required targets
Every request rechecks ADMIN, .csv/.xlsx, and 10MB constraints
Preview is read-only; row, mapping, and structural errors block confirmation
Confirm reparses/revalidates, rejects existing and intra-file duplicates, creates only new Users in one transaction, and rolls back all writes on failure
No backend route or service depends on importId or temp-store; AF-021 removes the remaining client importId flow
Unit/API/database tests cover mapping edge cases, authorization, statelessness, and atomic rollback
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build pass
files: src/lib/data/import/mapping.ts (new — suggestions and untrusted mapping validation)
src/lib/data/import/registrants.ts (update — apply source-index mapping and validate all rows)
src/lib/is-same-origin.ts (new — same-origin guard for stateful import requests)
src/lib/data/import/temp-store.ts (remove after all importId consumers are gone)
src/lib/data/import/registrants.test.mts (new/extend — row numbering, duplicates, and atomic create behavior)
tools/verify-af028-api.mjs (new — authenticated local API smoke test)
verification: Run focused Node tests, the dedicated local PostgreSQL transaction test, and tools/verify-af028-api.mjs against a local Next server configured only for the isolated test DB. Verify inspect, mapped preview, confirm/revalidation, invalid origin/mapping, duplicate replay, cleanup, then run lint/typecheck/build.
